visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a brightly lit indoor restaurant with wooden furnishings. A pair of hands places a large white tray onto a table, carrying three large burgers with sesame buns, a plate of fried noodles topped with an egg and chicken cutlet, a plate of fries and purple sweet potato balls, and a massive 1000cc glass of dark iced tea. (2) Close-up shots focus on a green promotional poster on a wall advertising a 'Big Eater Challenge' with illustrations of food and prizes. (3) A small blue digital timer is shown being set to 15:00. Close-up shots highlight the textures of the food: crispy golden fried chicken, fresh green lettuce inside burgers, and steam rising from the noodles. (4) A young man wearing a green long-sleeved shirt, glasses, and a black Nike cap sits at the table. He puts on transparent plastic gloves and begins eating. (5) A fast-paced montage shows him eating various items, starting with a sweet potato ball, then moving to a large piece of fried chicken, and then deconstructing the burgers to eat them more quickly. He takes large sips of the iced tea between bites. (6) The camera captures the progress as plates become empty. Finally, the man is seen being handed a red envelope containing several 100 TWD bills, smiling at the camera. (7) The visual shifts to a screen recording of a smartphone using the Skyscanner app, searching for hotels in Taichung with a price tag of 830 TWD shown. (8) The man is then shown inside a clean, modern hotel room with a large white bed; he jumps onto it in celebration. (9) Subsequent quick shots show him eating sushi and playing a large-scale Chinese chess game (xiangqi) in a grand lobby with chandeliers. (10) The video concludes with an exterior shot of the breakfast restaurant 'Roommate Breakfast' and its street address overlay.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track features a high-energy male narrator speaking Traditional Chinese with an enthusiastic and fast-paced delivery. The background music is an upbeat electronic pop track with a prominent synthesizer melody and a steady electronic drum beat. (2) As the narrator describes the food, clear foley sounds of a liquid being poured and the rustling of plastic are heard. (3) A sharp 'ding' sound effect highlights the start of the challenge. (4) During the eating montage, rhythmic crunching and swallowing sounds are emphasized in the mix. (5) The narration continues seamlessly as the topic shifts to a travel app recommendation, maintaining a professional yet persuasive tone. (6) A digital 'whoosh' sound effect accompanies the visual transition to the phone screen. (7) The music and vocals maintain a consistent balance until the very end, where the narrator ends with an upward inflection for a call to action.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Challenge Context -> Action/Eating Montage -> Success/Reward -> Integrated Product Placement -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves a dual purpose: first, it documents a high-energy 'Big Eater' food challenge at a specific restaurant in Taichung to engage viewers; second, it utilizes the creator's trip to Taichung to provide a sponsored endorsement for the Skyscanner travel app, demonstrating its utility in finding budget-friendly accommodations during work trips.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator directly introduces the Skyscanner app, shows a screen recording of the app's interface, mentions specific prices found, and verbally encourages the audience to use it for their own travels.

high_inference.freeDescribe: A typical social-media influencer video that expertly bridges viral 'challenge' content with professional commercial endorsement. The rapid pacing and high information density are tailored for high engagement on short-form video platforms.
